_about: Stage 1 asks domain + use_context + freight_direction in one call; stage 2 asks 'activity' with only the chosen domain's activities (skipped when the rules already picked an activity in that domain). The 'state' text is built by decider/cascade.build_state from the extracted line.

domain.instructions: Which kind of activity is this line item?

choices.fuel_combustion: Fuels burned in our own or controlled equipment or vehicles: diesel/HSD, petrol, LPG, PNG/CNG, coal, furnace oil, biomass, kerosene; also lines that are explicitly the upstream / well-to-tank emissions of a fuel
choices.refrigerant_fugitive: Refills or top-ups of refrigerant gas (R-22, R-32, R-410A...), CO2 fire extinguishers, SF6 switchgear gas
choices.industrial_gas: Industrial and welding gases bought in cylinders or bulk: argon, nitrogen, oxygen, acetylene, CO2 shielding gas, gas blends
choices.electricity: Purchased electricity: grid utility bills (MSEDCL, DVVNL...), open access, green tariff, renewable PPA; also lines that are explicitly grid T&D losses
choices.heat_steam_cooling: Purchased steam, hot water, district heating or chilled water
choices.water: Water supply or withdrawal: municipal water bills, tanker water, borewell, recycled water
choices.wastewater: Effluent or sewage discharge and treatment (CETP, ETP, STP charges)
choices.waste: Waste disposal, treatment or recycling: hazardous waste, scrap, e-waste, used oil, sludge, MSW; also waste hauling
choices.freight: Transport of goods by a third party: trucking, lorry receipts, courier, rail, sea or air freight, freight forwarding
choices.business_travel: Employee business travel: flights, trains, taxis, buses, hotel stays, travel agency bookings
choices.employee_commute: Getting employees to and from work: contracted staff buses, cabs, shuttle services, work from home
choices.purchased_goods: Raw materials, components, consumables, packaging and supplies bought for operations
choices.purchased_services: Services bought: maintenance, repair, calibration, testing, training, consulting, IT, security, housekeeping (not refills of refrigerant gas or CO2 fire extinguishers - those are fugitive emissions)
choices.capital_goods: Long-lived assets bought: machinery, plant equipment, vehicles, IT hardware, buildings, electrical equipment
choices.leased_assets: Rent or lease of offices, warehouses, equipment or vehicles without operator - paid by us (upstream) or, when we are the landlord, leased out to others (downstream)
choices.downstream_value_chain: What happens to products after we sell them: customers' processing, use of sold products, end-of-life / take-back / post-consumer recycling of sold products, franchises, investments
choices.non_activity: Not an emissions activity: taxes, statutory fees, permits, consent fees, fines, deposits, advances

use_context.instructions: If this is a fuel, where was it burned? (choose the closest even if not a fuel)

choices.stationary_equipment: Burned in fixed equipment we own or control: DG set, boiler, furnace, kiln, heater, canteen
choices.company_vehicle: Fuel for vehicles we own or lease (cars, trucks, buses in our fleet)
choices.offroad_equipment: Fuel for our forklifts, cranes, hydras, loaders or other mobile site machinery
choices.third_party_vehicle: Fuel paid for a transporter's or contractor's vehicle that we do not own

freight_direction.instructions: If this is goods transport, which direction and who pays?

choices.inbound: Goods coming to our site from a supplier
choices.outbound_paid_by_us: Goods we send to customers and we pay the transport
choices.between_own_sites: Goods moved between our own plants or warehouses
choices.outbound_paid_by_customer: Goods sent to customers where the customer pays the transport
choices.unknown: Cannot tell / not a freight item

fuel_combustion.fuel.diesel: High-speed diesel (HSD), light diesel oil (LDO), DG set or vehicle diesel
fuel_combustion.fuel.lpg: LPG, propane, butane cylinders or bulk LPG
fuel_combustion.fuel.natural_gas: Piped natural gas (PNG), CNG, RLNG, LNG
fuel_combustion.fuel.furnace_oil: Furnace oil (FO), heavy fuel oil (HFO), LSHS, bunker fuel
fuel_combustion.fuel.coal_bituminous: Steam coal, thermal coal, imported coal for boilers
fuel_combustion.fuel.coke_oven_coke: Met coke, hard coke, LAM coke
fuel_combustion.fuel.lubricants: Lubricating oil BURNED as fuel (rare - bought lubricants are purchased goods)
fuel_combustion.fuel.jet_kerosene: Aviation turbine fuel (ATF), Jet A-1 for owned aircraft
fuel_combustion.fuel.other_petroleum: Other refinery petroleum products used as fuel
fuel_combustion.fuel.wood: Firewood, wood chips, sawdust, wood waste
fuel_combustion.fuel.solid_biomass: Rice husk, bagasse, agro-waste briquettes, biomass pellets
fuel_combustion.fuel.msw_fuel: RDF / municipal waste burned as fuel
fuel_combustion.fuel.upstream_wtt: A line that is explicitly the well-to-tank / upstream (extraction, refining, transport) emissions of a fuel

refrigerant_fugitive.refrigerant.dcp_extinguisher: Dry chemical powder (ABC/DCP), foam or water fire-extinguisher refill or servicing - no greenhouse gas released

industrial_gas.gas.co2_process: CO2 used and released in process: welding/shielding CO2, beverage CO2, dry ice, CO2 blasting
industrial_gas.gas.argon: Argon gas (welding, inert atmosphere) - no direct GHG, purchased good
industrial_gas.gas.argon_co2_blend: Argon/CO2 mixed shielding gas (e.g. Ar 80% CO2 20%) - CO2 share is a process emission
industrial_gas.gas.oxygen: Oxygen gas or liquid oxygen (industrial or medical)
industrial_gas.gas.acetylene: Dissolved acetylene (DA) for gas cutting - burned, so a combustion emission
industrial_gas.gas.other: Other industrial gas (helium, specialty gas, calibration gas)

electricity.elec.grid: Grid electricity from a utility/DISCOM (MSEDCL, DVVNL, BESCOM, TANGEDCO...) - non-renewable mix
electricity.elec.renewable: Renewable electricity: green tariff, open-access solar/wind, PPA, I-REC/REC-backed supply
electricity.elec.captive_third_party: Electricity bought from a third-party captive/group-captive plant
electricity.elec.td_losses: A line that is explicitly grid transmission & distribution (T&D) losses or upstream generation of electricity

water.water.municipal: Municipal corporation, MIDC, water board or utility water supply
water.water.groundwater: Borewell / tubewell groundwater abstraction, CGWA charges
water.water.surface: River, canal, lake or dam water drawn
water.water.recycled: Recycled or treated water bought or reused (tertiary treated, STP water)

purchased_goods.goods.packaged_water: Packaged drinking water bottles/jars (a purchased good, not a withdrawal)
purchased_goods.goods.steel: Steel, iron, MS/SS sheets, rods, billets, pipes, castings
purchased_goods.goods.other_metals: Zinc, brass, nickel, lead and other metals
purchased_goods.goods.chemicals: Industrial chemicals, solvents, acids, paints, adhesives
purchased_goods.goods.paper_packaging: Paper, corrugated boxes, cartons, packaging material
purchased_goods.goods.electrical_components: Cables, switches, PCBs, motors, sensors, spares
purchased_goods.goods.consumables: Tools, welding electrodes, abrasives, PPE, lab supplies, spares
purchased_goods.goods.lubricants: Lubricating oil, engine/gear/hydraulic oil, grease (used, not burned)

wastewater.wastewater.discharge: Effluent/sewage sent to CETP, sewer or third-party treatment

waste.waste.haz_landfill: Hazardous waste sent to a TSDF secured landfill
waste.waste.haz_coprocessing: Hazardous waste co-processed in cement kilns
waste.waste.used_oil: Used/spent oil sent to authorised recycler
waste.waste.metal_scrap: Ferrous/non-ferrous scrap sold or sent for recycling
waste.waste.msw_landfill: General non-hazardous mixed waste to landfill
waste.waste.transport_only: Only transport of waste (waste hauling/carting) with no waste type, quantity or disposal route

freight.freight.road: Truck / lorry / tempo goods transport, GTA, lorry receipt (LR)
freight.freight.sea: Ocean/sea freight, container shipping, by-sea shipment
freight.freight.forwarding: Customs clearing, forwarding, cargo handling, loading/unloading

business_travel.travel.taxi: Taxi / cab / ride-hailing (Ola, Uber) for business trips
business_travel.travel.car_rental: Self-drive car rental or mileage claim
business_travel.travel.agency_fee: Travel agency service fee / convenience fee only

employee_commute.commute.staff_bus: Contracted staff bus / shuttle for employees
employee_commute.commute.cab: Contracted employee cabs for home-office pick-up/drop

purchased_services.service.calibration_testing: Calibration, testing, inspection, certification, lab analysis
purchased_services.service.consulting: Consulting, legal, audit, accounting, engineering services
purchased_services.service.manpower: Contract labour, security guards, housekeeping, facility management

capital_goods.capex.machinery: Production machinery, compressors, pumps, plant equipment

downstream_value_chain.downstream.processing: Further processing of our sold intermediate products by customers
downstream_value_chain.downstream.use_phase: Energy or fuel used by customers when using our sold products (use phase)
downstream_value_chain.downstream.end_of_life: End-of-life treatment of products we sold: customer take-back, post-consumer recovery and recycling
downstream_value_chain.downstream.investment: Equity or debt investments, project finance

leased_assets.lease.downstream: Assets we own and lease out to others (we are the landlord/lessor): sublet space, rented-out equipment
leased_assets.lease.building: Rent of office, warehouse or factory premises
leased_assets.lease.equipment_vehicle: Hire/rental of equipment or vehicles (cranes, hydra, forklifts, cars) without fuel

non_activity.none.tax_fee: Taxes, statutory/consent fees, permits, fines, deposits, rounding - not an emissions activity
